name: cobol-call-path-service-naming
body: Emitter.finish never resolves an EXEC CICS INVOKE SERVICE or WEBSERVICE target: it is an external unresolved call named by its literal text, or by the identifier's name when the target is a data item, even when the name matches a scanned program. Limit: a service given by a variable is reported under the variable's name rather than the runtime service name. Upgrade if facts need the service's runtime value traced.
